question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "boon".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• 'Boon' means a thing that is very helpful and that you are grateful for.
 
• Synonyms of 'Boon' are blessed, benefit, compliment, etc.
 
• Example: *Honey is a boon to those with weak digestion.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Favor means to prefer or support something.

 
 
• ​Example -* Would you do me a favor?*
 
 
 
• Asset means a person or thing which is useful for somebody.
 
 
• ​Example - *She is a great asset to the company.*
 
 
 
• A burden means that is difficult to carry.
 
 
• Example: I don't want to be a burden on my parents.
